summary.en: A strip of sheared triangles rolled into a polygonal tower that snaps between two stable states, tall and folded flat. Both are exact; between them the paper must stretch, so the tower has no rigid motion.
summary.es: Una tira de triángulos sesgados enrollada en una torre poligonal que salta entre dos estados estables, alta y plegada en plano. Los dos son exactos; entre ellos el papel tiene que estirarse, así que la torre no tiene movimiento rígido.
summary.fr: Une bande de triangles cisaillés roulée en une tour polygonale qui bascule entre deux états stables, haute et repliée à plat. Les deux sont exacts ; entre eux, le papier doit s'étirer, si bien que la tour n'a aucun mouvement rigide.
summary.pt: Uma tira de triângulos inclinados enrolada numa torre poligonal que salta entre dois estados estáveis, alta e dobrada rente. Os dois são exatos; entre eles o papel precisa esticar, por isso a torre não tem movimento rígido.

era: late 20th century (twist-buckling pattern studied by Biruta Kresling)
sources: B. Kresling, Natural twist buckling in shells: from the hawkmoth's bellies to the deployable Kresling-pattern and cylindrical Miura-ori, IASS-IACM 2008
S. D. Guest, S. Pellegrino, The folding of triangulated cylinders, Part I: geometric considerations, Journal of Applied Mechanics 61 (1994) 773–777
G. W. Hunt, I. Ario, Twist buckling and the foldable cylinder: an exercise in origami, International Journal of Non-Linear Mechanics 40 (2005) 833–843
J. Cai, X. Deng, Y. Zhou, J. Feng, Y. Tu, Bistable behavior of the cylindrical origami structure with Kresling pattern, Journal of Mechanical Design 137 (2015) 061406
